entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: A finished furniture item available in the catalog or evaluated by customers, excluding standalone sub-units and replacement parts.

entity_types.name: Assembly
entity_types.description: An intermediate structural sub-assembly, mechanism, or composite module within a product, excluding single monolithic parts.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: An individual physical part, hardware fastener, surface, or discrete piece of a product, excluding assembled multi-piece units.

entity_types.name: Defect
entity_types.description: A specific physical flaw, dimensional inaccuracy, material defect, or shipping damage, excluding subjective stylistic complaints.

entity_types.name: FailureMode
entity_types.description: An observable operational breakdown, instability, noise, or functional malfunction experienced during use or assembly, excluding cosmetic wear.

fact_types.description: Identifies which product an assembly belongs to, helping determine which product lines are impacted by sub-assembly failures.
Identifies which assembly contains a specific component, enabling defect localization to intermediate units.
Identifies direct product-to-component relationships when intermediate assemblies are not specified, tracing parts to finished goods.
Pinpoints the exact part exhibiting a manufacturing or material defect to isolate supplier quality issues.
Associates an intermediate assembly with a physical defect to isolate assembly-level production errors.
Identifies defects reported directly against the product to aggregate defect frequencies across the catalog.
Tracks what operational failure symptoms or performance malfunctions are reported for a given product.
Captures which specific sub-assemblies or mechanisms produce operational failures in the field.
Captures functional malfunctions originating from an individual component (such as noise or flickering).
Maps a root-cause physical defect directly to the observable operational malfunction experienced by the user.
Identifies which component or material defects prevent or complicate the proper assembly of the finished product.
